title: Training Designer: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Fitters need the leak-test hold point; the missing checklist is a system fix, not a training need.

items.title: Return to service
items.objective: Carry out and record a leak test before restart

items.title: Checking the part
items.objective: Check a critical spare's specification before fitting
content: What to do with a part that has none
assessment: Sort five parts into fit and hold

items.title: Releasing to service
items.objective: Check the test record before signing a release
content: The hold point and who signs it [FND-0002]
Refusing a release without a record
assessment: Review three work orders and decide on release

items.situation: The pump is back from a seal change and the test rig is unavailable.
prompts: Facilitator: listen for a refusal to restart

items.question: At which HFACS level is the missing checklist?
items.why: Tests whether the cause is placed at the level that owns the fix.

items.question: What record must exist before a pump restarts after a seal change?
items.why: Tests knowledge of the hold point.
items.good_evidence: Names the record and the signature

items.question: Why did the test step get missed?
items.why: Tests whether the cause is seen as a system gap.

items.question: What do you do with a seal that has no specification reference?
items.answer: Hold it and ask for technical approval.
items.good_evidence: Holds the part and names who approves

items.question: Who approves a substitute part?
items.why: Tests knowledge of the approving role.
items.answer: The reliability engineer or technical authority.
items.good_evidence: Names the role, not a person

items.question: What does a display-only gas alarm need from the crew?
items.answer: A person must act on it; it trips nothing.
items.good_evidence: Says the alarm needs a human response

items.question: At which HFACS level is local buying without a specification?
items.why: Tests placing a cause at the level that owns the fix.

items.question: Where is the leak-test result written down?
items.answer: On the work order before it closes.

items.question: What can a supervisor check before signing a release?
items.answer: That the test record is signed and complete.

items.question: Which fix is stronger than retraining for the missed test?
items.answer: A work order that cannot close without a test result.
items.good_evidence: Names a system change above training

rows: % of restarts with a test record
